announcements.headline: Results of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of a general meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments or statutory resolutions. It signifies standard corporate governance activity rather than a material change in the company's strategic or financial position.

announcements.headline: FINAL RESULTS FOR THE YEAR ENDED 31 MARCH 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement signifies the publication of the company's final annual results for the specified financial year. It provides shareholders with the official audited financial performance and position for that period.
